post.summary:
Complete a registration that was started from an app login request.
The email is read from the single-use token, not from the request body.

200.description: Account created and the user is signed in

CompleteRegistrationRequest.description:
Request to complete a registration that was started from a login request.
The email address is read from the single-use registration token and is
deliberately not part of this request.

token.description: Token from the registration link sent to the user's email
